idle: The sketch in your tablet is what we had time to draw. The land is larger than that.
If you lose the trail, stop. Look at the slope. The map only helps if it still matches the ground.
wren.missionNudge: The crew marked sites. North of here the trails split. I would start by standing on a marker and asking the tablet where it thinks you are.
wren.afterComplete: The radio site is still up there. A route on paper is not the same as a route you can walk.

items.name: Old lookout
items.text: From the platform the valley looks vertical. The sketch map in the tablet is a few pale lines. Standing here, you can see why those lines are not enough.
items.wrenHint: There is an old lookout on the west ridge. The drop from there will tell you more than a vocabulary word.
items.wrenAck: Tight land, tight lines — if you ever get contours.

items.name: High tarn
items.prompt: Cold water under a cold sky.
items.text: An alpine lake with a short dock. The surface is a map of the sky. Underneath is another map, if anyone measured depth.
items.wrenHint: The tarn sits west of the station. The dock is the easy way to ask how deep it is.
items.wrenAck: Water has a shape too. Not only land.

items.name: Broken switchback
items.prompt: The line on the sketch continues. The trail does not.
items.text: Loose rock, a bitten bank, and flagging that used to mark a switchback. A newer image of this slope would not agree with the old sketch.
items.wrenHint: The west trail used to be the short way. Used to.
items.wrenAck: If the map and the ground argue, believe the ground — then update the map.

items.name: West cliff
items.text: A cliff band. You can feel the slope in your knees. On a contour map this would be a tight stack of lines. The meadow to the east would not.
items.wrenHint: Walk the west face, then walk the east meadow. Same mountain. Different spacing.
items.wrenAck: Steep is not a word. It is how close the lines sit.

items.name: East meadow
items.text: A broad meadow. You can see the radio mast as a speck. The walk is longer. The land does not shove you backward.
items.wrenHint: The east side is the long way. Long is not always worse.

items.name: Uncharted basin
items.prompt: Stakes in a bowl the sketch never finished.
items.text: Elevation stakes stand in a small basin. Equal numbers belong on the same line — if you can tell which numbers match.
items.wrenHint: Northeast of the meadow someone left stakes and never drew the contours.
items.wrenAck: A contour is just the set of places that share a height.

items.name: Ridge survey
items.text: The junction. From here the radio site is still north, over a rise you cannot see in plan view until you draw a profile.
items.wrenHint: The survey point is where the trails meet, not at the mast.
items.wrenAck: A junction is a decision, not a destination.

items.name: Radio site
items.text: Wind, rock, and a locked instrument box. Getting here with a heavy case is a different problem than getting here with a day pack.
items.wrenHint: The radio site sits north of the junction, over the last rise.
items.wrenAck: Above treeline the map has fewer trees to hide behind. The land does not get simpler.
